identity.description: Reviews volume trends, TVL depth, active addresses, daily transactions, and market-cap context to identify weakening liquidity signals and exit-risk proxies before they become critical. Flags assets where high yield may be accompanied by thin market depth.

capabilities.dataCoverage: 59 assets, volume/TVL/address/transaction metrics, 8 quarters of trend data

inputs.description: Liquidity question with optional symbol, category, and warning thresholds.

outputs.description: Liquidity-health report with volume, TVL, activity proxies, mcap/TVL ratio, and explicit blind spots.

skill.userValue: Use volume, TVL, activity, and trend fields to identify liquidity and exit-risk questions for follow-up. Confirm live pool depth, slippage, venue concentration, and withdrawal constraints before acting.
